proof_body:
by
  intro f c hf
  exact ⟨tendsto_nhds_iff_meromorphicOrderAt_nonneg hf, tendsto_ne_zero_iff_meromorphicOrderAt_eq_zero hf, tendsto_zero_iff_meromorphicOrderAt_pos hf⟩
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ), MeromorphicAt f c → ((∃ L, Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin c {c}ᶜ) (nhds L)) ↔ 0 ≤ meromorphicOrderAt f c) ∧ ((∃ L, L ≠ 0 ∧ Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin c {c}ᶜ) (nhds L)) ↔ meromorphicOrderAt f c = 0) ∧ (Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin c {c}ᶜ) (nhds 0) ↔ 0 < meromorphicOrderAt f c)
